method: Whole-file manual reading of Russian localization; parsed every key and compared key sets and brace field names with English catalog.
findings: Russian catalog has full English key parity and matching brace-field names; no duplicate keys. This does not prove C++ format specification or rendered layout correctness.

Probable duplicates is explicitly Вероятные дубликаты, hash column Префикс хеша, sampled hash Выборочный хеш. Large-file sampling option names64МиБ threshold. These labels retain the distinction between sampling candidates and exact equality.

Recovery result explicitly says restored—verify file data; unallocated candidate says recovery possible, while same-volume confirmation warns about overwriting deleted data. Labels do not qualify recovery implementation against actual disks.

Visible translation shortcomings include Bytes and Item/Items remaining English, junctions rendered Перекрестки, sparsify rendered Сжать файл and regex alternative rendered глобальных шаблонов. These are upstream localization findings, not defects in our library.
Cloud warning describes avoiding downloads; advanced setting permits changing that behavior. Labels alone do not prove hydration avoidance under filesystem races.
limits: No rendered Russian interface, accelerator conflict, installer encoding or Windows runtime verified. No upstream files modified or copied into production.
